preconditions.description: The number of operators is between 1 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each operator is either 'typedef A B' or 'typeof A'
preconditions.description: Each operator is either a type definition or a type retrieval.

preconditions.expression: A and B are non-empty lines of no more than 20 lowercase Latin letters
preconditions.description: The type names A and B are non-empty and have a maximum length of 20 characters.

preconditions.expression: The number of asterisks and ampersands in A and B is at most 10
preconditions.description: The number of asterisks and ampersands in each type name is at most 10.

preconditions.expression: B does not have asterisks or ampersands
preconditions.description: The type name B, resulting from a typedef operation, does not contain asterisks or ampersands.

preconditions.expression: A does not have asterisks or ampersands when brought to void
preconditions.description: The type name A, when brought to void, does not contain asterisks or ampersands.

postconditions.expression: For every typeof operator, print the type that the operator returned
postconditions.description: The output for each typeof operator must be the type that the operator returned, as a string.

invariants.expression: The type system starts with void and errtype as the only types
invariants.description: The type system is initialized with void and errtype.

invariants.expression: The type system evolves according to the typedef and typeof operations
invariants.description: The type system is updated based on the typedef and typeof operations in the order they are given.
If a type is void, it is treated as errtype during operations.
If a type is errtype, it remains errtype regardless of the operation.

invariants.expression: The typeof operation returns the current definition of the type
invariants.description: The typeof operation returns the current type definition, which may be void, errtype, or a user-defined type.
